items.title: 67246_Buck Clayton oral history interview
items.q: I used to learn solos from Louis Armstrong and Cootie. Those were the main two.

ctx.x: And I just played jazz the way I felt like I wanted to play it. And I really didn't start to play like anybody until after school when I went back
to California. I used to learn solos from Louis Armstrong and Cootie. Those were the main two.
Where did you hear Cootie? Now this was, oh this would be with Duke?
